Research Proposal Abstract

Background  ›  Climate Vulnerability & GCM Gaps
2 / 10
Problem Statement: PICT Climate Risk & Uncertainty Motivation
Vulnerability of Pacific Small Islands
PICTs are on the frontline of global climate impacts, facing severe ocean warming, extreme heat stress, and coastal inundation due to their low-lying island geography.
Global Climate Model (GCM) Resolution Gaps
Standard CMIP6 global climate models underrepresent small island geographies. Tropical Cyclones (TCs) and extreme storm surges—major drivers of climate risk in the region—are not directly simulated in these models, creating high output uncertainty.
Decision-Making Gaps
  • Multidimensional Uncertainty: Decision makers often receive simple model averages without confidence bounds or spatial variance metrics.
  • Data Inaccessibility: Large NetCDF and raster datasets require specialized GIS expertise to extract actionable insights.
  • Platform Goal: Deliver a dual-interface platform (Bivariate Exploration Map + AI Chatbot) to communicate geographic insights alongside uncertainty bounds.

Architecture  ›  System Platform Overview
3 / 10
Dual Platform System Architecture & Motivation System Design
Module 1: earthlab-fiji-map
  • Role & Purpose: Serves as a targeted side-project testbed specifically used to prototype, benchmark, and optimize spatial analysis features and 2D bivariate map overlays before integrating them into the chatbot.
  • Key Features: 3×3 Bivariate matrix, GPU trace reduction (1,137 → 3 layers), dynamic H3 polyfilling (<2s build cache), and 111 CHVA facility spatial joins.
Module 2: pict-climate-risk-viz-chatbot
  • Role & Purpose: The primary main project and end-user decision-support platform designed for non-expert decision makers to interact with climate datasets via natural language.
  • Key Features: Minimalist conversational UI, 13 Python geospatial analytical tools, interactive MapCanvas, zonal stats drawer, and live SDMX data services.

Module 1  ›  Bivariate Map & GPU Optimization
4 / 10
Fiji Interactive Bivariate Map (earthlab-fiji-map) Data Viz
Interactive Fiji Map & H3 Hexagonal Grid fiji_optimized.html
3×3 Bivariate Classification
Combines projected temperature mean \(\text{raster\_mean}\) with model uncertainty \(\alpha\).
Uncertainty Metric \(\alpha\): Currently uses a mock inverse-temperature placeholder (\(1 - \text{normalized\_mean}\)) built on top of the bivariate choropleth function.
GPU Trace Rendering Optimization
Reduced Mapbox trace overhead from 1,137 separate traces down to 3 static GPU layers (\(\text{Choroplethmapbox}\)), completely resolving browser interaction freezes.
Brown University — EarthLab Slide 4 / 10
Module 1  ›  CHVA Healthcare Layer & H3 Gridding
5 / 10
CHVA Healthcare Facility Layer & H3 Polyfilling Spatial Join
111 CHVA Healthcare Facilities Spatial Join Layer
111 CHVA Healthcare Facility Dataset
  • Dataset Definition: Fiji Climate Change & Health Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA) dataset tracking 111 mapped healthcare infrastructure locations categorized by tier: Hospitals (Red), Health Centres (Orange), and Nursing Stations (Blue).
  • Spatial Join Overlay: Performed spatial overlay (\(\text{gpd.sjoin}\)) mapping GPS facility coordinates directly to administrative subdivision polygons.
Dynamic H3 Polyfilling & Geometric Cache
  • Multi-resolution Uber H3 hexagonal spatial binning (Resolutions 5, 6, 7).
  • Built geometric caching layer (\(\text{data/cache/}\)), cutting pipeline build time from ~30s down to <2s.
  • Truncated GeoJSON coordinates to 6 decimal places (~10 cm precision) for fast network transmission.

Module 2  ›  Spatial Selection & SDMX Ingestion
7 / 10
Spatial Query Engine & SDMX Live Backend Backend Service
Tikina Boundary Selection & MapCanvas Zonal Stats MapCanvas Drawer
Interactive MapCanvas & Draw Controls
  • Mapbox GL JS map canvas featuring thin boundary outlines, tooltips, and dynamic legends.
  • Interactive bounding box and polygon drawing controls (\(\text{DrawControls.tsx}\)).
  • Real-time zonal statistics computation over custom drawn polygons with live feedback to the chatbot interface.
Live SDMX Data API & H3 Binner
  • SDMX Protocol: Ingests live regional Pacific indicators directly from Pacific Data Hub (PDH) SDMX endpoints using \(\text{sdmxApiClient.js}\).
  • \(\text{h3Binner.js}\): Aggregates live climate metrics into H3 spatial cells on the fly.

13-Tool Python Analytical Geospatial Engine Tool Suite
Category Python Tool Modules Analytical Function
Spatial & Region spatial.py, region.py PICT region lookup, administrative boundary filtering
Climate Extremes climate.py, extremes.py, thresholds.py Anomaly calculation, extreme heat days, threshold exceedances
Aggregation & Trends statistics.py, aggregation.py, temporal.py Spatial/temporal aggregation, variance, trend lines
Risk & Vulnerability exposure.py, assets.py, ranking.py, asset_ranking.py Asset exposure calculation, infrastructure vulnerability ranking
Scenarios scenario.py Multi-scenario comparison & SSP pathway analysis
LLM Function Calling Engine
Enables the LLM to programmatically route natural language user queries (e.g., "Find vulnerable hospitals in Fiji exposed to extreme heat") directly to Python geospatial backend functions.

Roadmap  ›  Remaining Proposal Features
9 / 10
Remaining Features to Complete Proposal Future Work
Priority 0: Immediate Implementation
  • Full LLM Tool Execution Loop: Connect Express server to Python tool scripts via formal JSON Schemas.
  • Interactive Trend Line Charts: Time-series charts displaying historical vs. 2050/2100 warming pathways and confidence intervals.
Priority 1: High Impact Data Layers
  • True CMIP6 Model Variance: Replace mock \(\alpha\) with real spatial standard deviation (\(\text{raster\_std}\)).
  • Tropical Cyclone Hazard Layers: Ingest historical cyclone tracks, wind field vectors, and coastal storm surge inundation maps.
Priority 2 & 3: Platform Enhancements
  • RAG System for Metadata & Schemas: Vector-index spatial layer metadata, dataset headers, and analytical tool function schemas to improve LLM tool selection accuracy.
  • Brushing & Linking: Dynamic cross-filtering connecting map selections directly to chart visualizations and tabular facility views.
  • Low-Bandwidth Dashboard: Load Plotly via CDN to shrink \(\text{fiji\_optimized.html}\) from 18 MB to <500 KB.
  • React Flow Node Graph: Render visual execution graph of LLM spatial reasoning.
